correctness.rationale: A stationary independent last-run decomposition gives the beta attenuation, conditional vector-density Jacobian and exact all-rate inward event formula. originality.rationale: The known stationary positional density and Dirichlet mean law are not claimed as new. The exact current-heading joint disintegration, all-rate inward-heading probability, and its two sharp coefficients are compared against full available primary texts and current published records, including stronger positional coverage. The later comprehensive paper explicitly distinguishes velocity-position statistics from its full position-coordinate joint law. Novelty remains subject to external priority checking.
residual_risks: The abstract-only 2026 joint-velocity paper could contain relevant general formulas not captured by the abstract; it reports exact 1D states.
General Dirichlet-process, gamma-process and renewal theories could provide an equivalent inward-probability identity under a different formulation, and the record search is not exhaustive.

The full position--heading disintegration follows naturally from a known recursion; the assessed added value lies in the physically motivated sign observable and its two nontrivial sharp coefficients.
No independent scientific or publication-priority audit has been performed.

value.rationale: The fraction of time active propulsion points inward is a natural physical observable of 3D trap–heading alignment, not inferable from the known position marginal without a position-heading coupling. The theorem provides the exact dependence on all positive switching rates, strict positivity and upper bound, an explicit unit-rate benchmark, and exact physically interpretable limits in the strong persistence and strong mixing regimes. The high-rate constant requires local asymptotic density analysis beyond known moment scaling.
